userObserved.symptom: entire application black; JSON entering chat and old approximately 70 MB PNG import

confirmedCodeBehavior.finding: Enabled helper script calls bootstrap/open automatically. First display preference defaults to scene; new chat creates 3D scene/player even while academic setup pauses input/render.

Phone runtime is a single packaged 6,240,538-byte source string; it includes 4,348,110 tokenizer bytes. Mount immediately starts story-phone sync/ensure and injects the source into a parent script. This is additional parse/DOM work, not proven iOS crash or a measured heap total.

Live2D and scene renderers are mutually exclusive via v-if/else. Models are pooled one template per appearance, player requested immediately, NPC loads requested only for nearby rendered crowd. Thus simultaneous startup of Live2D and all 3D models is not established.

Current local Helper 4.9.1 createSrcContent wraps module content directly and does not macro-substitute script payload. Final bundle has zero literal closing script tags and one embedded-phone marker. User phone Helper revision was not inspected.

3D uses WebGL2 through Three; construction is caught and context loss switches to static fallback. Pixel ratio capped 1.65. Visibility pauses frames; unmount retires context. No device-specific iOS texture budget/capability gate found. Context failure is not proved to cause whole-app black.

pagehide shuts down shell/phone; there is no matching pageshow bootstrap. A persisted document restore may require reloading the helper, but this predicts missing shell/native UI, not whole-App black at first import.
